facts.fact: The full local snapshot contains owners, types, exact dependency interfaces/types/selections, blobs, dependencies and retirements. Dependency interfaces alone do not carry supplier bodies.

Existing source containers carry exact source objects and package selections. Their admitted closure has complete per-package snapshots. Deriving admission from its witness would retain a Rust semantic boundary.
Root stores three map roots: owners, dependencies and retirements. Package identity, repository identity and package name are bound. Owners include unused syntax.
Logical map commitments can be recomputed from sorted key/value entries without physical map pages. Current unit-map code is specialized to 17-byte keys and 65-byte values.

Semantic state binds schema versions, package ID/name and logical owner/dependency/retirement map roots. It deliberately excludes repository identity and physical page locators. A source schema can recompute exact state from complete sorted records without porting the repository page reader.

Revision identity separately binds repository ID, up to2ordered parents and semantic state. Digest includes epochLE16 and canonical payload lengthBE64; semantic state deliberately excludes repository ID.

Use only byte serialization/closure collection in the initial Rust exporter; no trusted type tables, semantic validation certificates, normalized instructions or serialized executable output.
